name: p_agenda_bloqueos_empleados_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_empleado = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM empleados e
  WHERE ((e.id_empleado = agenda_bloqueos_empleados.id_empleado) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), e.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_agenda_excepciones_sucursal_select_scope
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal))

name: p_agenda_excepciones_sucursal_bloques_select_scope
using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agenda_excepciones_sucursal e
  WHERE ((e.id_excepcion_sucursal = agenda_excepciones_sucursal_bloques.id_excepcion_sucursal) AND (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), e.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_bitacoras_admin_only
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (roles_usuarios ru
     JOIN roles r ON ((r.id_rol = ru.id_rol)))
  WHERE ((ru.id_usuario = auth.uid()) AND (ru.activo = true) AND (r.nombre = 'admin'::text)))))

name: p_bloqueos_select_scope
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal) OR (id_empleado = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())))

name: p_citas_select_scope
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal) OR (id_empleado_barbero = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())) OR (creada_por_usuario_id = auth.uid()) OR ((id_cliente IS NOT NULL) AND (id_cliente = fn_cliente_id_por_uid(auth.uid()))))

name: p_citas_update_staff
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal) OR (id_empleado_barbero = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())))

name: p_citas_detalles_select_scope
using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM citas c
  WHERE ((c.id_cita = citas_detalles.id_cita) AND (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal) OR (c.id_empleado_barbero = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())) OR (c.creada_por_usuario_id = auth.uid()) OR ((c.id_cliente IS NOT NULL) AND (c.id_cliente = fn_cliente_id_por_uid(auth.uid())))))))

name: p_holds_select_scope
using:
((id_usuario = auth.uid()) OR fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM citas c
  WHERE ((c.id_cita = citas_holds.id_cita) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_clientes_select_scope
using:
((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_usuario = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM citas c
  WHERE ((c.id_cliente = clientes.id_cliente) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal))))))

name: p_empleados_select_scope
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_empleado = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal))

name: p_horarios_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_empleado = fn_empleado_id_por_uid(auth.uid())) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM empleados e
  WHERE ((e.id_empleado = horarios_semanales_empleados.id_empleado) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), e.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_horarios_sucursales_select_scope
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), id_sucursal))

name: p_horarios_sucursales_bloques_select_scope
using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM horarios_semanales_sucursales hss
  WHERE ((hss.id_horario_sucursal = horarios_semanales_sucursales_bloques.id_horario_sucursal) AND (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), hss.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_notif_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_usuario_destino = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (roles_usuarios ru
     JOIN roles r ON ((r.id_rol = ru.id_rol)))
  WHERE ((ru.id_usuario = auth.uid()) AND (ru.activo = true) AND (r.nombre = 'admin'::text)))))

name: p_payment_events_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (payment_intents pi
     JOIN citas c ON ((c.id_cita = pi.id_cita)))
  WHERE ((pi.id_intent = payment_events.id_intent) AND ((pi.created_by_usuario_id = auth.uid()) OR fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal))))))

name: p_intents_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (created_by_usuario_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM citas c
  WHERE ((c.id_cita = payment_intents.id_cita) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal)))))

name: p_payments_select_scope
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM payment_intents pi
  WHERE ((pi.id_intent = payments.id_intent) AND ((pi.created_by_usuario_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM citas c
          WHERE ((c.id_cita = pi.id_cita) AND fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(auth.uid(), c.id_sucursal)))))))))

name: p_points_select_self
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_cliente = fn_cliente_id_por_uid(auth.uid())))

name: p_roles_usuarios_select_scope
using:
((id_usuario = auth.uid()) OR fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (roles_usuarios ru2
     JOIN roles r2 ON ((r2.id_rol = ru2.id_rol)))
  WHERE ((ru2.id_usuario = auth.uid()) AND (ru2.activo = true) AND (r2.nombre = 'admin'::text) AND (NOT (ru2.id_sucursal IS DISTINCT FROM roles_usuarios.id_sucursal))))))

name: p_subpay_select_self
using:
(fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM subscriptions s
  WHERE ((s.id_suscripcion = subscription_payments.id_suscripcion) AND (s.id_cliente = fn_cliente_id_por_uid(auth.uid()))))))

name: p_subs_select_self
using: (fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()) OR (id_cliente = fn_cliente_id_por_uid(auth.uid())))

name: p_usuarios_select_self
using: ((id_usuario = auth.uid()) OR fn_is_super_admin(auth.uid()))
